display.name: NGINX insights
display.description: NGINX access and error logs on pursotin, using the project's default VictoriaLogs datasource. Totals use step-aligned chart buckets, so boundary buckets may extend slightly beyond the selected time range. Rates adapt to the chart interval. Response sizes exclude HTTP headers. Request latency is unavailable in the current log format.

display.name: Requests
display.description: Total access-log entries across the selected chart buckets. Boundary buckets are rounded to the query step.

display.name: 4xx responses
display.description: Client-error responses across the selected chart buckets, including rejected requests and missing resources. Boundary buckets are rounded to the query step.

spec.query: {host="pursotin",service="nginx",log_type="access"} | stats count() if (status:>=400 status:<500) as client_errors

display.name: 5xx responses
display.description: Server-error responses across the selected chart buckets, including upstream failures. Boundary buckets are rounded to the query step.

spec.query: {host="pursotin",service="nginx",log_type="access"} | stats count() if (status:>=500 status:<600) as server_errors

display.name: Response body bytes
display.description: Total body_bytes_sent across the selected chart buckets. Boundary buckets are rounded to the query step. HTTP headers and inbound traffic are not included.

display.name: Request rate
display.description: Requests per second, averaged within each chart interval.

display.name: Response body bandwidth
display.description: Response-body bytes per second, averaged within each chart interval. HTTP headers are excluded.

display.name: Traffic by HTTP status
display.description: Requests per second split by HTTP status code.

display.name: 5xx response percentage
display.description: Percentage of requests returning 5xx in each chart interval, not an average error percentage for the whole selected range.

spec.query: {host="pursotin",service="nginx",log_type="access"} | stats count() as requests, count() if (status:>=500 status:<600) as errors | math 100 * errors / max(requests, 1) as error_percent | fields _time, error_percent

display.name: Requests by bot category
display.description: User-agent estimates across the selected chart buckets: AI bots take precedence over search bots, then other crawlers. Categories are mutually exclusive. Unclassified includes browsers, unidentified bots, and missing user agents; it does not mean human. User agents can be spoofed. Boundary buckets are rounded to the query step.

spec.query: {host="pursotin",service="nginx",log_type="access"} | format "Unclassified" as traffic_class | format if (http_user_agent:~"(?i)bot|crawler|spider|slurp|scrapy|facebookexternalhit|facebot|ia_archiver|archive.org_bot") "Other crawlers" as traffic_class | format if (http_user_agent:~"(?i)googlebot|googleother|bingbot|bingpreview|adidxbot|duckduckbot|yandexbot|yandeximages|baiduspider|applebot|petalbot|sogou|slurp") "Search bots" as traffic_class | format if (http_user_agent:~"(?i)gptbot|chatgpt-user|oai-searchbot|claudebot|claude-user|claude-searchbot|anthropic-ai|cohere-ai|cohere-training-data-crawler|perplexitybot|perplexity-user|bytespider|amazonbot|meta-externalagent|meta-externalfetcher|google-extended|applebot-extended|ccbot|ai2bot|diffbot|omgilibot|omgili") "AI bots" as traffic_class | stats by (traffic_class) count() as requests

display.name: Traffic share by bot category
display.description: Percentage of requests in each chart interval, not an average for the whole selected range. User-agent heuristics with precedence AI > search > other crawlers; unclassified is not necessarily human. AI includes known AI retrieval, training, and dataset crawlers. Declared identities are not verified; robots.txt-only tokens such as Google-Extended cannot identify traffic when absent from the user agent.

spec.query: {host="pursotin",service="nginx",log_type="access"} | format "Unclassified" as traffic_class | format if (http_user_agent:~"(?i)bot|crawler|spider|slurp|scrapy|facebookexternalhit|facebot|ia_archiver|archive.org_bot") "Other crawlers" as traffic_class | format if (http_user_agent:~"(?i)googlebot|googleother|bingbot|bingpreview|adidxbot|duckduckbot|yandexbot|yandeximages|baiduspider|applebot|petalbot|sogou|slurp") "Search bots" as traffic_class | format if (http_user_agent:~"(?i)gptbot|chatgpt-user|oai-searchbot|claudebot|claude-user|claude-searchbot|anthropic-ai|cohere-ai|cohere-training-data-crawler|perplexitybot|perplexity-user|bytespider|amazonbot|meta-externalagent|meta-externalfetcher|google-extended|applebot-extended|ccbot|ai2bot|diffbot|omgilibot|omgili") "AI bots" as traffic_class | stats count() as requests, count() if (traffic_class:="AI bots") as bots | math 100 * bots / max(requests, 1) as percent | format "AI bots" as traffic_class | fields _time, traffic_class, percent

display.name: Top crawler and bot user agents
display.description: Top 20 recognized bot user agents by request count over the selected time range. Expand rows for category, user agent, and request count. Classification is heuristic; unknown or disguised bots are excluded. Rows are displayed most recently seen first.

spec.query: {host="pursotin",service="nginx",log_type="access"} | format "Unclassified" as traffic_class | format if (http_user_agent:~"(?i)bot|crawler|spider|slurp|scrapy|facebookexternalhit|facebot|ia_archiver|archive.org_bot") "Other crawlers" as traffic_class | format if (http_user_agent:~"(?i)googlebot|googleother|bingbot|bingpreview|adidxbot|duckduckbot|yandexbot|yandeximages|baiduspider|applebot|petalbot|sogou|slurp") "Search bots" as traffic_class | format if (http_user_agent:~"(?i)gptbot|chatgpt-user|oai-searchbot|claudebot|claude-user|claude-searchbot|anthropic-ai|cohere-ai|cohere-training-data-crawler|perplexitybot|perplexity-user|bytespider|amazonbot|meta-externalagent|meta-externalfetcher|google-extended|applebot-extended|ccbot|ai2bot|diffbot|omgilibot|omgili") "AI bots" as traffic_class | filter NOT traffic_class:="Unclassified" | stats by (traffic_class, http_user_agent) count() as requests, field_max(_time, _time) as _time | sort by (requests desc, traffic_class, http_user_agent) limit 20 | format "<requests> requests | <traffic_class> | <http_user_agent>" as _msg

display.name: Requests by virtual host
display.description: Total requests by vhost across the selected chart buckets, sorted busiest first. Boundary buckets are rounded to the query step. The vhost includes the listening port.

display.name: HTTP status distribution
display.description: Total requests by HTTP status code across the selected chart buckets. Boundary buckets are rounded to the query step.

display.name: Most requested paths
display.description: Top 20 vhost/path pairs by total requests in the selected time range. Query strings are excluded and HTTP methods combined. Rows are displayed most recently seen first; expand for structured vhost, path and request-count fields.

spec.query: {host="pursotin",service="nginx",log_type="access"} | extract_regexp "^[^ ]+ (?P<path>/[^? ]*)" from request | filter path:* vhost:* | stats by (vhost, path) count() as requests, field_max(_time, _time) as _time | sort by (requests desc, vhost, path) limit 20 | format "<requests> requests | <vhost> | <path>" as _msg

display.name: Recent 4xx / 5xx requests
display.description: Latest 100 failed requests in the selected time range. Expand a row for vhost, status, client address, request and user agent.

spec.query: {host="pursotin",service="nginx",log_type="access"} status:>=400 status:<600 | sort by (_time desc) limit 100

display.name: Recent NGINX error-log entries
display.description: Latest 100 error-log entries in the selected time range, including warnings and notices. An empty panel means no matching entries were ingested.
